data.long_meaning: In Old High German, Gisela means 'pledge', 'hostage', or 'pledge'. In Germanic mythology, hostages were given as a sign of good faith and were meant to ensure peace between warring parties. This name carries the powerful meaning of commitment, loyalty, and trust. The name Gisela carries the meaning “Pledge, hostage, pledge” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gisela usually hope their child will grow to embody pledge, hostage, pledge and live with faith, good character and purpose.
